title: ConfigBundleRecipe
description: Schema for Brotni config-bundle recipe v1. Defines how a configuration or policy bundle candidate is materialized, applied, observed, and evaluated inside a simulation campaign. The candidate's identity is the immutable content digest of the bundle, not a mutable version label.

apiVersion.description: API version of the recipe spec.

name.description: Unique name identifying this recipe instance.

description.description: Human-readable description of the config bundle and its purpose.

configuration.description: The configuration/policy bundle under evaluation. Provide exactly one of `data` (inline) or `ref` (external reference).

data.description: Inline configuration content as a string.

ref.description: Reference to an externally stored bundle (e.g. an OCI artifact or object store path).

digest.description: Content digest of the referenced bundle for reproducibility.
Explicit SHA256 digest of the inline configuration content. This is the candidate's immutable identity.

appliesTo.description: Optional logical target the configuration applies to (e.g. service name or component).

provider.description: Source provider (e.g., github, gitlab, nexus, artifactory).

commit.description: Exact commit SHA the bundle was produced from.

validation.description: How the configuration bundle should be validated before the run.

schema.description: Path or URI of a schema the configuration must satisfy.

rules.description: Named assertion rules evaluated against the configuration.

apply.description: How the configuration is applied within the simulation context.

mountPath.description: Filesystem path where the configuration is materialized inside the run.

envPrefix.description: When set, configuration keys are also exposed as environment variables with this prefix.

reloadCommand.description: Optional command to signal the target to reload configuration.

outputs.description: Declared output paths for the simulation to collect.

timeouts.description: Timeout configuration for the simulation run.

runSeconds.description: Maximum seconds for the simulation run.

requireDigest.description: If true, the simulation environment must reject bundles without a content digest.

recordConfigDigest.description: If true, the simulation environment records the resolved configuration digest for audit.
